brief.product_or_service: Small-group beginner pottery workshops at a neighborhood ceramics studio
brief.campaign_goal: Drive bookings for weekend workshop sessions
brief.target_audience: Adults looking for a welcoming, hands-on weekend activity, including people with no pottery experience
brief.key_message: Beginner-friendly, two-hour wheel-throwing sessions include tools and materials
required_disclosures: Participants must be at least 16 years old. Advance booking is required.

creative.headline: Try the pottery wheel this weekend
creative.primary_text: Curious about making pottery? Join a relaxed, beginner-friendly wheel-throwing session and get hands-on with clay, tools, and materials. No prior experience is needed. Participants must be at least 16 years old; advance booking is required.
creative.description: Two-hour small-group workshops for first-time potters.
